verdict.rationale: Solid templates are JSX, and Solid is built on TypeScript with an official tsconfig setup ("jsx": "preserve", "jsxImportSource": "solid-js"). That routes template expressions through the TypeScript compiler's JSX type checking rather than limiting checks to separate script blocks. However, the pack only implies this; no source explicitly describes template-level type checking. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on JSX/template type checking (e.g. typed props and attributes, error examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of the TS-in-template experience.
